conditions.has_open_sessions: at least one open session is listed
conditions.app_enabled: the app that provides this page is installed and enabled
conditions.full_dashboard: the full dashboard is open, not an embedded chat or sessions view
conditions.no_active_session: no session is open in the chat pane
conditions.has_schedules: at least one scheduled job exists
conditions.search_bar_unclaimed: no enabled app has claimed the top-bar search (an app that does turns it into its own launcher)
conditions.session_open: a session is open in the chat pane
conditions.no_response_running: the open session is not answering right now (the control is disabled while a response runs)
conditions.empty_session: the open session has no messages yet
conditions.not_on_sessions_page: the open page is not Sessions (on a phone, Sessions has its own drawer instead)
conditions.has_closed_sessions: at least one closed session is in the history
conditions.older_sessions_collapsed: the Older Sessions list is collapsed
conditions.sessions_board_view: the sessions list is in Board view, with sessions in columns (switch it from the sessions ⋯ menu)
conditions.sessions_list_view: the sessions list is in List view (the default)
conditions.pointer_on_session_row: the pointer or keyboard focus is on a session row of this machine that is not being renamed (the control is drawn on that row)
conditions.terminal_enabled: the terminal is turned on in Settings
conditions.phone_connect_available: pairing a phone is available on this machine
conditions.kiro_account_entry: the menu offers a Kiro account row (always when this installation runs on Kiro; with another backend, only once an account usage reading has arrived)
conditions.has_notifications: at least one notification is listed
conditions.has_unread_notifications: at least one notification is unread
conditions.notification_selected: a notification is open in the detail panel (select it in the list)
conditions.notification_read: the open notification is already read (opening one marks it read; an unread one shows Mark read here instead)
conditions.crewmate_selected: a crewmate is selected in the list
conditions.crewmate_editor_open: a crewmate's editor is open (choose Edit on that crewmate)
conditions.has_installed_apps: at least one app is installed
conditions.app_details_open: an app's detail page is open (in Discover, click the app's card)
conditions.app_tile_menu_open: the app card's ⋯ (More actions) menu is open (in Library, point at the app's card to show ⋯, then click it; clicking the card itself opens the app instead)
conditions.job_open: a scheduled job's detail panel is open (select the job in the list)
conditions.job_running: the open job is running now
conditions.job_secret_request_pending: the open job is waiting for a secret approval
conditions.job_details_tab: the job panel's Details tab is selected (the default; the Logs tab hides this)
conditions.schedule_list_view: the Schedule page shows its List view (the default; the Calendar and Executions views hide this)
conditions.jobs_checked: one or more jobs are checked in the list
conditions.one_job_checked: exactly one job is checked in the list (tick that job's own box)
conditions.skill_selected: a skill is selected in the list
conditions.message_typed: something is ready to send: text in the message box, an attached file, or a referenced session
conditions.board_missing_state_lanes: one of the Board view’s default status columns was removed (this appears only then)
conditions.response_running: the open session is answering right now
conditions.message_box_empty: nothing is waiting to send: no text in the message box and no attached file (with either, this place holds Queue or Steer instead)
conditions.mouse_input: the device is used with a mouse or trackpad, not a touchscreen
conditions.touch_input: the device is used by touch (a tablet or touchscreen), so the message box shows its touch controls
conditions.goal_loop_running: a goal loop is running in the open session (its panel then offers Pause)
conditions.monitor_running: a monitor is watching for the open session and has not finished (its panel then offers Stop monitor)
conditions.screen_capture_available: taking a screenshot is supported here (the desktop app, or a Mac)
conditions.context_usage_reported: the open session has reported how full its context is (after its first answer)
conditions.new_channel_prompt: the first notification from a new channel is asking whether to keep or mute that channel
conditions.crewmate_danger_zone_open: the crewmate editor shows its Danger zone section (choose Danger zone in the editor's section list)
conditions.crewmate_panel_not_docked: the crewmate's details panel is not already docked open beside the chat
conditions.open_app_not_installed: the open app is not installed yet and can be installed from the dashboard
conditions.open_app_enabled: the open app is a regular installed app (not a built-in or independently managed one) and is turned on
conditions.open_app_syncable: the open app is a regular installed app with no newer version waiting; Sync reloads its installed files and does not install a new release
conditions.open_app_update_available: the open app is a regular installed app and a newer version is waiting (Update stands where Sync otherwise is)
conditions.open_app_removable: the open app is a regular installed app (not a built-in or independently managed one) that is not locked against removal
conditions.job_not_running: the open job is not running now (while it runs, Cancel Run stands in this place)
conditions.nav_rail_expanded: the navigation rail is expanded, showing labels
conditions.cloud_deploy_available: this installation can publish to a public cloud URL (the built-in AWS destination is offered)
conditions.voice_input_supported: this browser can record from a microphone (the mic button is not drawn otherwise)
conditions.job_enabled: the open job is active (not paused)
conditions.crewmate_place_pane_open: the crewmate editor shows its Memory section (choose it in the editor's section list)
conditions.crewmate_model_pane_open: the crewmate editor shows its General section, which holds the model (choose it in the editor's section list)
conditions.artifact_open: an artifact's own page is open (click the artifact in the library)
conditions.terminal_not_popped_out: the terminal is docked in the dashboard, not popped out to its own window
conditions.terminal_docked_bottom: the terminal panel sits below the chat (the default)
conditions.terminal_docked_right: the terminal panel sits to the right of the chat, side by side with it

labels.uiLocations.description.chat_memory_mode: The memory mode button above the message box. It switches this chat to incognito or temporary memory, or back to persistent.
labels.uiLocations.description.chat_model_picke: The model button in the message box. It shows this chat's model and opens the model picker.
labels.uiLocations.description.chat_session_tit: The session's title at the top of the chat. Its text is the session's name; click it to rename the session.
labels.uiLocations.description.composer_approva: The approval-mode picker in the message box's control row. It sets whether tool calls ask first (Normal), run reads without asking (Reads), trust this session (Trust), or auto-approve everything (YOLO).
labels.uiLocations.description.composer_voice_i: The microphone button in the message box. Press it to dictate instead of typing; on a touchscreen it switches between the keyboard and hold-to-talk.
